listing.name: Dead or Alive Xtreme 2 — DOAX2 Recomp (hibikifukui22)
listing.summary: Release/input options documented; full progression coverage unknown. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Dead or Alive Xtreme 2 Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Retail base version 3 / XEX2; title 544307D2/media 21B9628E; no TU.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the Windows release and place your own retail disc files in game. Use the base game; title updates are not supported.
